identifiableFields.description:
If both objects being compared are {@link Identifiable} and either isA the other, normally only the `id` field
is used to determine equality. If this flag is set, the exact type and all fields of the instances are compared
in this case as well.

title:
This spec is the optional argument used to control the behavior when determining the equality of values.

@see Value#valuesEqual
name: ValuesEqualSpec
